minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2023

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order by CHAIR YOO at 7:01 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Yoo, Medawar, Nicklas, Olson, Repp-Loadsman
  Romanelli, Schachter

  City Staff Present:  Jeannie Naughton, Community Development Director
  Katrina Kawagoe, Assistant Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, OCTOBER 2, 2023.

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES FOR THE MEETING OF
  OCTOBER 2, 2023.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6A.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

NONE

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-220386; LOCATION: 39 EMPTY SADDLE CLUB;
  APPLICANT: MICHAEL HASEGAWA (ON BEHALF OF VERIZON WIRELESS); A request
  for a Conditional Use Permit (CUP-220387) for a new stealth telecommunication facility
  featuring a 64’-high monoeucalyptus structure located toward the rear of the property
  including 17 antennas (8 panel antennas, 4 CBRS antennas, 4 C-Band antennas, and 1
  microwave antenna) and 16 wireless radios on 4 arrays, a 342 square-foot lease area that
  features 3 equipment cabinets, 1 generator and will be fully enclosed with an 8’-high CMU
  wall.

Assistant Planner Kawagoe stated that Verizon Wireless requested that this item be continued to
the February 5, 2023 Planning Commission meeting. This item will be re-noticed to a 500’ radius
from the subject property and republished in the newspaper. Staff will also send notices via email
specifically to residents who submitted correspondence on this item.

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES,
NOVEMBER 6, 2023
  1
 9.  COMMISSIONER ITEMS

NONE

10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

A. PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 230037; LOCATION: CITYWIDE; COMPREHENSIVE
  ZONING CODE UPDATE - COMMERCIAL DISTRICT (VERBAL REPORT)

Director Naughton stated that coming up for the December 4, 2023 Planning Commission
meeting, staff will bring Development Standards for review and finalized draft versions of the Use
Regulations. She also provided a brief overview of the next steps; staff anticipates adoption of
the zoning ordinance in early 2024.

11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS – SEPTEMBER 26, 2023

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS – OCTOBER 10, 2023

VICE CHAIR MEDAWAR made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER NICKLAS to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM 11A

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

At 7:05 p.m., CHAIR YOO adjourned the Planning Commission meeting to the next regular
Planning Commission meeting scheduled for Monday, December 4, 2023 at 7:00 p.m.in the City
Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates.

Respectfully submitted by,  Approved,

Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst  Victor Yoo, Chair

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES,
NOVEMBER 6, 2023
